speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe exactly how your cough feels, and does it produce any mucus? If so, what color is the mucus and how much do you cough up? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hyperinflation of the lungs, flattened diaphragm, no acute infiltrates.

speaker: Doctor
text: That X-ray suggests air trapping, which is often seen in obstructive lung diseases. How many years has this cough been present, and do you experience wheezing or difficulty breathing when you exercise or at night? REQUEST TEST: Spirometry

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
